pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with deeply jagged, leaf-like serrated edges. High geometric complexity with multiple acute-angled projections. Individual dark regions on the flank are large and densely packed, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes on the lower posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space forming a topological grid. Junction nodes predominantly feature tri-radiate and quadri-radiate intersections. Pixel thickness of pathways is relatively narrow and uniform across the mid-flank, widening significantly as patches fragment in the lower ventral area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-textured, low-amplitude serration along the mane from the mid-neck to the shoulder, creating a continuous fringe silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism (oxpecker) perched on the dorsal ridge at the junction of the neck and shoulder.
